alt: 穿綠色外套的人微笑遞出小禮物，另一隻手卻趁攤主轉身整理水果時，偷偷拿走錢袋裡的硬幣。
scene_prompt: A fictional adult in a neat green cardigan smiles politely and offers a shopkeeper a small gift with one hand across a market counter. Behind their own back the other hand secretly opens the shopkeeper's unattended coin pouch and removes coins. Side-on composition clearly reveals both the friendly front and the concealed theft to the viewer, while the shopkeeper cannot see it. No weapons; careful natural anatomy and exactly two hands per person.
